criteria.text: Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Whitlock Systems Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 27 April 2026 (120 days after signing on 28 December 2025) and identifies that expected clearance on 11 June 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,400,000 (3 x ($4,800,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,300,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the Redcliffe Robotics Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.3 is stated as $8,100,000 but 15% of the $45,000,000 Purchase Price is $6,750,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,400,000 and the Seller's $3,300,000.
Gives the long-stop period as 120 days and as the date 27 April 2026, with days remaining from 7 January 2026 (110 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
